lines.cap: This horse can do it standing up.
lines.say: This horse can do it standing up.

lines.cap: Horses can doze on their feet, for hours, without falling over.
lines.say: Horses can doze on their feet, for hours, without falling over.

lines.cap: The trick is in the legs. Tendons and ligaments, called the stay apparatus, lock them in place.
lines.say: The trick is in the legs. Tendons and ligaments, called the stay apparatus, lock them in place.

lines.cap: In the back legs, the kneecap hooks over a bump on the thigh bone, like a latch.
lines.say: In the back legs, the kneecap hooks over a bump on the thigh bone, like a latch.

lines.cap: For an animal that gets hunted, it means it can run the second danger shows up.
lines.say: For an animal that gets hunted, it means it can run the second danger shows up.

lines.cap: But there's a catch. For deep, dreaming sleep, a horse has to lie down.
lines.say: But there's a catch. For deep, dreaming sleep, a horse has to lie down.

lines.cap: So in a herd, they take turns. One stays up on guard, while the others lie down.
lines.say: So in a herd, they take turns. One stays up on guard, while the others lie down.

lines.cap: So yes, he can do it standing up. Just not all night.
lines.say: So yes, he can do it standing up. Just not all night.
